info.title: sferik.net
info.summary: Erik Berlin's personal website, as an API
info.description: Every resource is one URL, and the Accept header picks its format: application/json for data, text/plain for terminal output (also what `*/*` gets, so plain `curl` works), text/html for the page where there is one, and for the resume also application/x-latex and application/pdf. Instead of the header, add .json, .txt, .tex, or .pdf to the path. A format the resource doesn't have gets 406, and a path that isn't a resource gets 404 (components.responses.NotFound). The two POSTs answer in plain text, or in JSON for a client that prefers it, where an error has a code to tell it from the others by. Responses allow any origin, except the pages.

post.description: The shell's write sferik. The body is the message, as plain text (5,000 bytes at most), emailed on, with a Reply-To if it includes an email address. One message a minute from an address, and twenty a day in all. Answers in plain text, or in JSON for a client that prefers it. With an Idempotency-Key, a message that may not have arrived can be sent again: the same key within a day is the same message, which is answered as sent and not emailed twice. One asked after while it's still being sent is answered 409, with the seconds to wait before asking again. Same origin only.
